💾 Data Backup & Restore
File move karne se pehle yeh karo!
📤 Step 1 — Data Export Karo
Saara data ek .json file mein save hoga. Yeh file apne paas rakh lo — kabhi bhi restore kar sakte ho.
📥 Step 2 — File Move Karo, Phir Restore Karo
File Desktop pe move karo, open karo, phir yahan exported .json file select karo. Data wapas aa jayega!
📋 File Move Karne ka Safe Tarika:
1️⃣ Export karo — backup.json download hogi
2️⃣ HTML file ko Desktop pe Copy karo (Cut mat karo abhi)
3️⃣ Desktop se file open karo
4️⃣ Restore karo — backup.json select karo
5️⃣ Data aa gaya? Tab Downloads wali file delete karo ✅

🆕 What's New
Saare latest changes aur how-to guide
v10.1
🏭
Semi-Finished / Sub-Assembly Stock
Ab internally manufactured items (jaise Stud) ko alag track kar sakte ho.
Kaise Use Karein:
1
Stock mein item edit karo
2
Internally Manufactured toggle ON karo
3
Ingredients set karo (TPE: 45g, M10 Bolt: 2 pcs)
4
Save → 🏭 button aa jayega
5
🏭 dabao → qty daalo → ingredients auto deduct
📊
Daybook — Category Drill Down
Category pe tap karo → us category ki saari entries popup mein.
Kaise Use Karein:
1
Daybook kholo
2
Category Breakdown mein koi category tap karo
3
Popup mein date-wise entries, total, avg dikhega
4
Income aur Expense dono alag sections
🎯
Daybook — 30 Discipline Rules
Entry save karte waqt smart warnings — company ko financially strong rakhti hain.
Kaise Use Karein:
1
Entry save karo normally
2
Rule trigger hua toh Discipline Check popup aayega
3
Red = fix zaroori, Yellow = warning only
4
Settings mein thresholds customize karo
💰
Daybook — Income Categories bhi
Ab expense ke saath income categories bhi breakdown mein dikhti hain.
Kaise Use Karein:
1
Daybook → Category Breakdown scroll karo
2
Upar Kharcha section, neeche Aaya section
3
Dono pe tap karke drill down
📋
Stock — Full History Tab
Purchase, Batch, Manufacture, Manual — saari entries ek jagah.
Kaise Use Karein:
1
Stock module mein neeche scroll karo
2
Item / Type / Source / Date filters use karo
3
Saari history bina kisi limit ke dikhti hai
🛒
Purchase Entry — Delete Option
Galat purchase entry delete kar sakte ho — stock bhi reverse hoga.
Kaise Use Karein:
1
Purchase Entry module jaao
2
Recent entries mein delete button dabao
3
Confirm karo — stock auto reverse
🧾
Batch se Invoice — Auto Fill
Batch close karte waqt invoice banao toh party details automatically fill hogi.
Kaise Use Karein:
1
Batch close karo → Invoice Banao
2
Party naam, address, phone, GSTIN auto fill
3
Party Ledger mein customer details update rakho
📈
Analytics Module
5 tabs — Production, Financial, Stock, Customer, Dispatch — charts ke saath.
Kaise Use Karein:
1
Sidebar mein Analytics button dabao
2
5 tabs mein se choose karo
3
Period filter se 3/6/12 months ya All Time dekho
4
Saara data charts + tables mein
☁️
Data Loss Protection Fix
Critical bug fix — empty local data cloud pe overwrite nahi karega.
Kaise Use Karein:
1
Automatic hai, koi action nahi
2
Sync dot Green = safe, Red = internet issue
3
Red dikh toh internet check karo band karne se pehle
🆕
What's New Page

Kaise Use Karein:
1
Sidebar mein neeche What's New button
2
Har change tap karo → steps expand hote hain
3
Naya update aane pe yellow dot dikhega
